title: Kumbhakarna enters the abode of Ravana
introduction: Kumbhakarna enters the abode of Ravana and sees his worried brother sitting in Pushpaka, a self-moving aerial car. Kumbhakarna asks Ravana about the nature of work to be done by him and whether he has to kill anyone. Ravana replies that Rama has come with troops of monkeys including Sugreeva, after crossing the ocean by a bridge, to wage a battle Ravana requests Kumbhakarna to show his terrible prowess in killing all the adversaries in battle.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 62nd Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
स तु राक्षसशार्दूलो निद्रामदसमाकुलः |
राजमार्गम् श्रिया जुष्टम् ययौ विपुलविक्रमः
verses.iast:
sa tu rākṣasaśārdūlo nidrāmadasamākulaḥ |
rājamārgam śriyā juṣṭam yayau vipulavikramaḥ
verses.translation: That Kumbhakarna of great prowess and the foremost, having full of intoxicating drowsiness, marched along the king's highway, full of royal dignity.

glosses.meaning: but filled with an intoxicating drowsiness

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसानाम् सहस्रैश्च वृतः परमदुर्जयः |
गृहेभ्यः पुष्पवर्षेण कीर्यमाणस्तदा ययौ
verses.iast:
rākṣasānām sahasraiśca vṛtaḥ paramadurjayaḥ |
gṛhebhyaḥ puṣpavarṣeṇa kīryamāṇastadā yayau
verses.translation: Then, that Kumbhakarna, who was very difficult to be conquered, accompanied by thousands of demons, sallied forth, covered with a shower of flowers from the houses (lining the way).

glosses.meaning: strewn with a shower of flowers

verses.devanagari:
स हेमजालविततम् भानुभास्वरदर्शनम् |
ददर्श विपुलम् रम्यम् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्
verses.iast:
sa hemajālavitatam bhānubhāsvaradarśanam |
dadarśa vipulam ramyam rākṣasendraniveśanam
verses.translation: He saw Ravana's abode, covered with golden grilled windows, spacious and looking beautiful, like a shining sun.

glosses.meaning: with appearance of a shining sun.

verses.devanagari:
स तत्तदा सूर्य इवाभ्रजालम् |
प्रविश्य रक्षोधिपतेर्निवेशनम् |
ददर्श दूरेऽग्रजमासनस्थम् |
स्वयंभुवम् शक्र इवासनस्थम्
verses.iast:
sa tattadā sūrya ivābhrajālam |
praviśya rakṣodhipaterniveśanam |
dadarśa dūre'grajamāsanastham |
svayambhuvam śakra ivāsanastham
verses.translation: Entering Ravana's palace, like the sun entering a mass of clouds, Kumbhakarna then saw from of distance his brother seated on a throne, as Indra saw Brahma perched on his seat.

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन् रक्षोगणसमन्वितः |
कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत् मेदिनीम्
verses.iast:
bhrātuḥ sa bhavanaṃ gacchan rakṣogaṇasamanvitaḥ |
kumbhakarṇaḥ padanyāsairakampayat medinīm
verses.translation: While going to his brother's palace, that Kumbhakarna, accompanied by troops of demons, caused the earth to shake with his stamping strides.

verses.devanagari:
सोऽभिगम्य गृहम् भ्रातुः कक्ष्यामभिविगाह्य च |
ददर्शोद्विग्नमासीनम् विमाने पुष्पके गुरुम्
verses.iast:
so'bhigamya gṛham bhrātuḥ kakṣyāmabhivigāhya ca |
dadarśodvignamāsīnam vimāne puṣpake gurum
verses.translation: Reaching his brother's house and entering the inner apartment, Kumbhakarna saw his worried brother sitting in Pushpaka, a self-moving aerial car.

verses.devanagari:
अथ दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णमुपस्थितम् |
तूर्णमुत्थाय सम्हृष्टः सम्निकर्षमुपानयत्
verses.iast:
atha dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇamupasthitam |
tūrṇamutthāya samhṛṣṭaḥ samnikarṣamupānayat
verses.translation: On seeing Kumbhakarna who arrived there, Ravana then quickly rose up from his seat, delighted and brought him nearer to his side.

verses.devanagari:
अथासीनस्य पर्यङ्के कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः |
भ्रातुर्ववन्दे चरणौ किम् कृत्यमिति चाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
athāsīnasya paryaṇ^ke kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ |
bhrāturvavande caraṇau kim kṛtyamiti cābravīt
verses.translation: Then, the mighty Kumbhakarna having offered salutation to the feet of his brother sitting on a sofa, asked him, "What is to be done?"

verses.devanagari:
उत्पत्य चैनम् मुदितो रावणः परिषस्वजे |
स भ्रात्रा सम्परिष्वक्तो यथावच्छाभिनन्दितः
कुम्भकर्णः शुभं दिव्यम् प्रतिपेदे वरासनम् |
verses.iast:
utpatya cainam mudito rāvaṇaḥ pariṣasvaje |
sa bhrātrā sampariṣvakto yathāvacchābhinanditaḥ
kumbhakarṇaḥ śubhaṃ divyam pratipede varāsanam |
verses.translation: Rising up from his seat, Ravana embraced him. That Kumbhakarna, who was thus embraced and made happy by his brother, occupied an auspicious, charming and excellent seat.

verses.devanagari:
स तदासनमाश्रित्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः
सम्रक्तनयनः क्रोधाद्रवणम् वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
sa tadāsanamāśritya kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ
samraktanayanaḥ krodhādravaṇam vākyamabravīt |
verses.translation: Resting on that seat, the mighty Kumbhakarna, with his blood-shot eyes in anger, spoke to Ravana as follows:

verses.devanagari:
किम्मर्थमहमादृत्य त्वया राजन् प्रबोधितः
शस कस्माद्भयम् तेऽत्र को वा प्रेतो भविष्यति |
verses.iast:
kimmarthamahamādṛtya tvayā rājan prabodhitaḥ
śasa kasmādbhayam te'tra ko vā preto bhaviṣyati |
verses.translation: "O king! For what purpose have I been woken up by you, with effort? Tell me from whom is the danger for you here and who is to be killed."

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातरम् रावणः क्रुद्धं कुम्भकर्णमवस्थितम्
रोषेण परिवृत्ताभ्याम् नेत्राभ्याम् वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
bhrātaram rāvaṇaḥ kruddhaṃ kumbhakarṇamavasthitam
roṣeṇa parivṛttābhyām netrābhyām vākyamabravīt |
verses.translation: Ravana, with his eyes rolling with annoyance, spoke to Kumbhakarna, his brother, who was there with anger (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
अयम् ते सुमहन् कालः शयानस्य महाबल
सुषुप्तस्त्वम् न जानीषे मम रामकृतम् भयम् |
verses.iast:
ayam te sumahan kālaḥ śayānasya mahābala
suṣuptastvam na jānīṣe mama rāmakṛtam bhayam |
verses.translation: "O mighty Kumbhakarna! You slept for a long period. You, who were fast asleep, do not know about the fear created by Rama in me."

verses.devanagari:
एष दाशरथी रामः सुग्रीवसहितो बली
समुद्रम् लङ्घयित्वा तु कुलम् नः परिकृन्तति |
verses.iast:
eṣa dāśarathī rāmaḥ sugrīvasahito balī
samudram laṇ^ghayitvā tu kulam naḥ parikṛntati |
verses.translation: "This Rama, the son of Dasaratha, a strong man along with Sugreeva, having crossed the ocean, is cutting short our race."

verses.devanagari:
हन्त पश्यस्व लङ्कया वनान्युपवनानि च
सेतुना सुखमागत्य वानरैकार्णवम् कृतम् |
verses.iast:
hanta paśyasva laṇ^kayā vanānyupavanāni ca
setunā sukhamāgatya vānaraikārṇavam kṛtam |
verses.translation: "Alas! See! Coming happily by a bridge, the forests and groves have been covered with an ocean full of monkeys."

verses.devanagari:
ये राक्षसा मुख्यतमा हतास्ते वानरैर्युधि
वानराणाम् क्षयम् युधे न पश्यामि कथंचन |
न चापि वानरा युद्धे जितपूर्वाः कदाचन
verses.iast:
ye rākṣasā mukhyatamā hatāste vānarairyudhi
vānarāṇām kṣayam yudhe na paśyāmi kathaṃcana |
na cāpi vānarā yuddhe jitapūrvāḥ kadācana
verses.translation: "The monkeys killed very important demons in battle. I do not envisage, in any way, the destroyable of monkeys on the battle-field. It seems the monkeys were not even defeated at any time before, in a combat."

verses.devanagari:
तदेतद्भयमुत्पन्नम् त्रायस्वेह महाबल |
नाशय त्वमिमानद्य तदर्थम् बोधितो भवान्
verses.iast:
tadetadbhayamutpannam trāyasveha mahābala |
nāśaya tvamimānadya tadartham bodhito bhavān
verses.translation: "O mighty Kumbhakarna! Such a danger has arisen. You have to help us now. Get them destroyed now. You have been woken up solely for that purpose."

verses.devanagari:
सर्वक्षपितकोशम् च स त्वमभ्युपपद्य माम् |
त्रायस्वेमाम् पुरीम् लङ्काम् बालवृद्धावशेषिताम्
verses.iast:
sarvakṣapitakośam ca sa tvamabhyupapadya mām |
trāyasvemām purīm laṇ^kām bālavṛddhāvaśeṣitām
verses.translation: "Rescuing me, whose treasury has become completely diminished, you protect this city of Lanka, where only the children and the aged are left over."

glosses.meaning: whose treasury has become completely diminished
where the children and the aged only are left over.

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातुरर्थे महाबाहो कुरु कर्म सुदुष्करम् |
मयैवम् नोक्तपुर्वो हि कश्चिद्भ्रातः परम्तप
verses.iast:
bhrāturarthe mahābāho kuru karma suduṣkaram |
mayaivam noktapurvo hi kaścidbhrātaḥ paramtapa
verses.translation: "O the great armed Kumbhakarna. For the sake of your brother, perform this act, which is very difficult to do. O brother, the annihilator of enemies! In this way, I did not request anyone ever before."

glosses.meaning: which is very difficult to do
for the sake of this brother
It was not indeed requested before

verses.devanagari:
त्वय्यस्ति मम च स्नेहः परा सम्भावना च मे |
दैवासुरेषु युद्धेषु बहुशो राक्षसर्षभ
त्वया देवाः प्रतिव्यूह्य निर्जिताश्चासुरा युधि |
verses.iast:
tvayyasti mama ca snehaḥ parā sambhāvanā ca me |
daivāsureṣu yuddheṣu bahuśo rākṣasarṣabha
tvayā devāḥ prativyūhya nirjitāścāsurā yudhi |
verses.translation: "I have a great respect and affection towards you. O the foremost of demons! For several times, in battles between gods and demons, you conquered the celestials and demons, after attacking them in the battle."

glosses.meaning: in battles between celestials and demons

verses.devanagari:
तदेतत्सर्वमातिष्ठ वीर्यम् भीमपराक्रम्
न हि ते सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यते सदृशो बली |
verses.iast:
tadetatsarvamātiṣṭha vīryam bhīmaparākram
na hi te sarvabhūteṣu dṛśyate sadṛśo balī |
verses.translation: "O Kumbhakarna of terrible prowess! Therefore, show your entire prowess. There is indeed no one, in the entire beings, who is equal to you in strength."

glosses.meaning: no strong person is indeed seen

verses.devanagari:
कुरुष्व मे प्रियहितमेतदुत्तमम् |
यथाप्रियम् प्रियरण बान्धवप्रिय |
स्वतेजसा विधम सपत्नवाहिनीम् |
शरद्घनम् पवन इवोद्यतो महान्
verses.iast:
kuruṣva me priyahitametaduttamam |
yathāpriyam priyaraṇa bāndhavapriya |
svatejasā vidhama sapatnavāhinīm |
śaradghanam pavana ivodyato mahān
verses.translation: "O Kumbhakarna, delighting in war and feeling affection for relatives! Perform this excellent act, which is dear and beneficial to me, as per your liking. Blow away the army of adversaries by your vital power, as an autumnal cloud is blown away by a high-rising wind."

glosses.meaning: as an autumnal cloud (is blown away)
